answer: A sybil operator tells one fable through many mouths because copies are free, so bind each identity to a distinct physical sensor bolted to a fixed site that streams signed noise - wind, heat, vibration - minute by minute. Neighbours on the same mesa must record correlated weather yet never identical traces; validators cross-check the signal against nearby devices and satellite data. A clone would need real hardware in a real place producing a plausible independent stream for its whole life, so faking a thousand identities means deploying a thousand separated sensors, not spinning up code.
